name: Edit Distance & Levenshtein
description: Two dynamic-programming edit-distance algorithms: unit-cost minimum edit distance and Levenshtein's variant, where a substitution costs 2. A JavaScript port of the first powers this site's search.
highlights: O(mn) table: each cell is the cheapest of an insert, delete or substitution
Compares both cost models on word pairs like "INTENTION" → "EXECUTION"
Try it: search this page with a typo or two, using the bar at the top
